statBlock.name: Behir
statBlock.description: A twelve-legged cave hunter that races up walls and blasts escaping prey with lightning. Legends credit storm giants with creating behirs to hunt dragons and raid their nests.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and use Constrict.
Bite. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.
Constrict. A visible Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it takes 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled, escape DC 16. It is Restrained until the grapple ends.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a line 90 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. It takes 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure the behir swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The behir can hold one swallowed creature at a time.
Inside the behir. The creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. It takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.
Regurgitation. If the swallowed creature deals at least 30 damage to the behir on one turn, the behir makes a DC 14 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure the behir spits the creature out, and it falls Prone within 10 ft. If the behir dies, the creature is no longer Restrained and can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.

statBlock.name: Bulette
statBlock.description: This heavily armored land shark tracks movement from underground. It bursts through the surface to snatch prey and can overrun whole herds.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Deadly Leap. Spend 5 ft. of movement to leap to a space within 15 ft. containing at least one Large or smaller creature. Every creature in that space makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature Prone. Success halves the damage and pushes it 5 ft. directly away from the bulette.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

statBlock.name: Abominable Yeti
statBlock.description: An abominable yeti claims whole stretches of frozen mountain country and may follow trespassers for days. It hurls ice from afar and closes to strike with its claws or breathe killing cold.

sections.Traits: Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Claw and Ice Throw. The yeti can also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Ice Throw. Ranged attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Chilling Gaze. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. It takes 21 (6d6) cold damage on a failure and is Paralyzed until the start of the yeti's next turn unless it is immune to cold damage. On a success it becomes immune to this abominable yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.
Cold Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. It takes 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

statBlock.name: Yeti
statBlock.description: A pale, horned hunter that blends into the snow and waits near mountain routes used by herders and travelers. It can freeze prey with a look or hurl conjured ice.

sections.Traits: Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Claw and Ice Throw. The yeti can also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Ice Throw. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.
Chilling Gaze. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failure and is Paralyzed until the start of the yeti's next turn unless it is immune to cold damage. Success grants 1 hour of immunity to every ordinary yeti's Chilling Gaze. Abominable yetis can still affect the creature.

statBlock.name: Remorhaz
statBlock.description: A full-grown remorhaz ambushes prey from tunnels under snow and ice. Its centipede-like body radiates heat, and its bite holds prey in place long enough for it to swallow.

sections.Traits: Heat Aura. At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, every creature in a 5-ft. Emanation from it takes 16 (3d10) fire damage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 17, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz makes a DC 19 Strength save. On a failure the remorhaz swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The remorhaz can hold up to two swallowed creatures.
Inside the remorhaz. Each swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. At the start of each of the remorhaz's turns it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Regurgitation. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the remorhaz on one turn, the remorhaz makes a DC 15 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it spits out all swallowed creatures, and each falls Prone within 5 ft. If the remorhaz dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained and each can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.

statBlock.name: Young Remorhaz
statBlock.description: A young remorhaz burrows through snow and ice, then chases down prey and sears it with its bite and the heat radiating from its body.

sections.Traits: Heat Aura. At the end of each of the young remorhaz's turns, every creature in a 5-ft. Emanation from it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

statBlock.name: Purple Worm
statBlock.description: A gigantic burrower that chews through earth and rock in search of food. It swallows smaller creatures whole and can leave entire settlements wrecked in its wake.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed. It leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 19, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.
Tail Stinger. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm makes a DC 19 Strength save. On a failure the worm swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The worm can hold up to three swallowed creatures.
Inside the worm. Each swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. At the start of each of the worm's turns it takes 17 (5d6) acid damage.
Regurgitation. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the worm on one turn, the worm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it spits out all swallowed creatures, and each falls Prone within 5 ft. If the worm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained and each can spend 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.
